app.tagline2: Works with any Magic Wormhole client

badge.noWasm: Your browser does not support WebAssembly. Use a modern browser or the wormhole command line.

send.dropTitle: Drop files or a folder here
send.dropHint: or choose below. Nothing is uploaded to a server: it is encrypted in your browser.
send.textHint: Sent as message.txt: the receiver sees it inline.
send.codeHelp: The receiver types it in Receive, or scans the QR code.
send.keepOpen: Keep this page open until the transfer ends.
send.zipNote: Several files are sent as one zip.

receive.title: Enter the code
receive.codeHelp: Single-use code. It is cleared as soon as you press Receive.

settings.title: Servers
settings.hint: Leave a field empty to use this site's server. ws:// and wss:// only. Applies to the next transfer, stays in this browser.
settings.invalid: Enter a valid ws:// or wss:// URL

about.title: How it works
about.p1: This page is a Magic Wormhole client running entirely in your browser (WebAssembly). Keys are negotiated with SPAKE2 and data is encrypted with NaCl SecretBox on your device: the server never sees your files.
about.p2: It talks to every Magic Wormhole client: send from the browser and receive on the command line, or the other way round.
about.entangle: Handing over a coding session? Get entangle

footer.basedOn: Based on wormhole-page by Luca Martinetti (MIT)

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Connect to the internet to transfer files.
